{X : Type u_1} →
  [inst : MeasurableSpace.{u_1} X] → MeasureTheory.Measure.{u_1} X → (X → ℝ) → ℝ
approved_definition_context: Measure comparison is comparison on all measurable sets. ENNReal.ofReal takes the nonnegative part into the nonnegative extended reals; scalar multiplication of a measure scales its mass. Integrable means genuine Bochner integrability, and ≤ᵐ[m] means almost-everywhere comparison under m.

The anonymous target is a literal definition with body: (∫ x, g x * Real.log (g x) ∂μ) - (∫ x, g x ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, g x ∂μ). Real.log 0 = 0 and the integrals are real Bochner integrals, not extended-real integrals.
